text: American Family Insurance operates as a mutual: American Family Mutual Insurance Company, S.I. sits under American Family Insurance Mutual Holding Company (AFIMHC), which the company states is owned by its policyholder-members, with American Family Connect, Homesite and Main Street America under the same group.

source.name: Wisconsin Office of the Commissioner of Insurance filing: American Family Mutual Insurance Company policyholder letter on its 2016-17 mutual holding company restructuring
source.quote: continue to operate under the principles and culture of a mutual company, owned by our policyholder-members
